toml:
# LEO-PNT focus area: high-accuracy positioning (precise point positioning, PPP).
#
# Adding a low Earth orbit (LEO) layer shortens PPP convergence because the LEO geometry
# changes in minutes rather than hours, which separates the float ambiguities from the
# position quickly. The trade: a lower orbit changes geometry faster but puts fewer
# satellites in view. The campaign sweeps the altitude of a 192-satellite Walker layer
# (12 planes, 60 deg) at 500, 1000 and 1500 km over a multi-GNSS float PPP (GPS, Galileo,
# BeiDou and GLONASS, ionosphere-free code and phase) at one mid-latitude site, and
# records the median time for the horizontal and vertical errors to stay under 10 cm
# (six noise realisations per altitude, 30 s epochs, so times come in half minutes).
#
# Reference trend: Li et al. 2019 (J Geodesy, doi 10.1007/s00190-018-1195-2) simulated
# 60, 96, 192 and 288 LEO satellites at 1000 km cutting multi-GNSS convergence from 9.6
# to 7.0, 3.2, 2.1 and 1.3 min; `leo-ppp-convergence` compares the engine with that
# table. This sweep is a design study around it, not a reproduction.
#
# MODELLED: float PPP with white code and phase noise and a random-walk zenith wet
# delay; no ambiguity resolution, no multipath.
kind = "campaign"
title = "PPP convergence against the altitude of a 192-satellite LEO layer"
seed = 20260929

[sweep]
metrics = [
  { name = "gnss_only_convergence", path = "cases[0].median_convergence_min" },
  { name = "gnss_leo_convergence", path = "cases[1].median_convergence_min" },
  { name = "mean_sats_in_view", path = "cases[1].mean_sats" },
]

[[sweep.axes]]
name = "leo_altitude"
key = "case.0.system.0.shell.0.altitude_km"
unit = "km"
start = 500.0
stop = 1500.0
steps = 3

[sweep.scenario]
kind = "leo-ppp"
seed = 20
duration_s = 1800.0
step_s = 30.0
runs = 6

[[sweep.scenario.site]]
lat_deg = 48.1
lon_deg = 11.6

[[sweep.scenario.gnss]]
name = "GPS"
preset = "gps-baseline"
mask_deg = 7.0

[[sweep.scenario.gnss]]
name = "Galileo"
preset = "galileo"
mask_deg = 7.0

[[sweep.scenario.gnss]]
name = "BeiDou"
preset = "beidou-meo"
mask_deg = 7.0

[[sweep.scenario.gnss]]
name = "GLONASS"
preset = "glonass"
mask_deg = 7.0

[[sweep.scenario.case]]
name = "192 LEO"

[[sweep.scenario.case.system]]
name = "LEO-192"
mask_deg = 7.0

[[sweep.scenario.case.system.shell]]
total = 192
planes = 12
phasing = 1
altitude_km = 1000.0
inclination_deg = 60.0
